## Why visit

One of the most distinctive pub experiences near Manchester: a surviving Victorian station buffet where the marble-topped bar, fireplace and railway memorabilia make the setting integral to the visit. The old buffet core and adjoining rooms deserve time, while the changing cask range supplies a proper beer reason to stay. In colder months the operator advertises warming local food, including black peas. This can be a rewarding standalone excursion without attempting the full Transpennine ale trail. Confirm train operation and station access for your dates before using it as a rail-linked stop.
